model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume connects technical work to measurable changes.
write_up: This is a strong payments engineering resume! At Tidewater, you show how you moved authorization into a Go service, improved ledger reconciliation and led an audit team. The work has enough detail for a recruiter to understand both your technical and team leadership.

The ledger line is a great model: it names what you built and shows the change in reconciliation breaks. Your Northwind work backs up the same story with an invoicing API and a faster generation process. The progression into senior payments work is easy to follow.
I'd make one small addition to the observability line, then send it. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a call back; the competitiveness of a particular job will still matter.
